{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()]

# Check if there are any rows with non-numeric revenue values
len(non_numeric_revenue), non_numeric_revenue.head()"}
